articles.title: Durban selected as South Africa’s candidate for Olympic bids in 2036 and 2040
articles.summary: Games would be first held in Africa if bid successful East-coast city preferred to Johannesburg and Cape Town South Africa on Thursday announced the east coast city of Durban as its preferred candidate to host the first Olympics in Africa. articles.title: ‘We built this land’: descendants of enslaved people are reclaiming their history across South Africa’s vineyards
